name: Nihongo Master v1.4.1 - Unified Katakana Racer Graphics & Mechanics
changelog: v1.4.1: Unified Katakana Arcade racer graphics and mechanics with Hiragana Arcade racer. Katakana mode now features identical high-octane road physics, road hazards (oil slicks, traffic cones with advance warning markers), rival AI archetypes (swerving weavers, lane-blocking trucks, high-speed rivals), slipstream drafting (DRAFT boost), near-miss bonuses, match combo streaks with floating score popups and pill chips, dynamic chassis steering tilt, glowing tail brake lights, and tire smoke/turbo flame particles.
